items.q: How does the AI resume parser work?
items.a: When a candidate uploads a CV, we extract raw text and send it to an AI model that identifies structured fields — contact info, experience, education, skills, certifications, and more — then populates the candidate profile automatically.

items.q: How is the ATS score calculated?
items.a: Each resume is scored across experience, skills, formatting, education, and achievements, plus keyword density and recruiter readability. Scores are generated by an AI model and are fully explainable with specific suggestions.

items.q: How does AI job matching work?
items.a: We generate vector embeddings for every resume and job description, then combine semantic similarity search (pgvector) with an AI reasoning pass to produce a match score, strengths, missing skills, and interview probability.
Yes. PRA uses role-based access control, row-level security on every table, encrypted storage, and full audit logging. Only authorized recruiters at your company can see your candidates' data.

items.q: Can I use PRA without AI features?
items.a: Yes — every AI feature is additive. You can run the platform as a traditional ATS and enable AI screening, matching, and scoring whenever you're ready.

ResumeIntelligence.checklistSubtitle: Deterministic checks -- not AI opinion -- run against your primary resume's parsed content.

email.fail: No email address detected — add one so recruiters can reach you.

phone.fail: No phone number detected — add one so recruiters can reach you.

summary.warning: No professional summary detected — a short summary helps recruiters skim your fit quickly.

length.warning: {words} words — consider trimming to roughly one to two pages.
length.fail: Only {words} words — likely too short for recruiters to judge your fit.

quantified.pass: Experience descriptions include quantified, measurable details.
quantified.fail: Few numbers found in your experience — add measurable impact (e.g. "increased X by 20%").
quantified.warning: No experience descriptions to evaluate yet.

weak_phrasing.pass: No passive or weak phrasing detected.
weak_phrasing.warning: Passive phrasing found ("{phrase}") — lead with a strong action verb instead.

action_verbs.pass: Bullet points use strong action verbs.
action_verbs.warning: Consider opening bullet points with strong action verbs (Led, Built, Improved...).

cliches.warning: Generic phrase found ("{phrase}") — replace with specific evidence.
